title: Multi-Form, Transformation, Lifecycle & Appearance-State Management
objective: Support one entity across owner-approved Forms, lifecycle stages, disguises/presentation identities and temporary appearance states, with explicit inheritance, stale-derivative behavior and comparison/transition previews without replacing the owning Form/state machine.
boundaries: MCCS-18 is presentation/state-management tooling over owner-approved forms and lifecycle states; Character/NPC/Creature/Species/Form owners retain canonical identity, mechanics and live-state truth.
MCCS-01 through MCCS-16 remain completed foundations and are not reopened.
Form/state inheritance, replacement and retention must be explicit; no silent semantic mutation is allowed.
Stale derivatives and unsupported/unresolved transitions remain explicit.
MCCS-19+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
ui-implementation and player-species lanes remain independently governed and unchanged by this selection.
next_action: After this queue-bound governed-start publishes, reserve and activate the separate Multiversal-app FIFO turn before preparing the MCCS-18 RED candidate.
